project_type: MEAN stack bus booking application - Angular 17.3.0 standalone components + Express.js + MongoDB + Mongoose 8.4.0
build_system: npm for both frontend and backend. Frontend uses Angular CLI 17.3.7, backend uses nodemon for development
test_framework: Frontend: Jasmine + Karma (ng test). Backend: Jest 30.5.2 (npm test)
build_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build (produces dist/frontend/browser/). Backend: no build step, runs with nodemon index.js
test_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm test. Backend: cd frontend/server && npm test
verification_instructions: 1. Start MongoDB locally or ensure MONGODB_URI env var is set. 2. Start backend: cd frontend/server && npm start (runs on port 5001). 3. Start frontend: cd frontend && npm start (runs on port 4200). 4. Test authentication via Google Sign-In in navbar. 5. Test protected routes (/profile, /payment, /my-trips). 6. Test new features: community platform, notifications, i18n selector, route planner, theme toggle, reviews.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Frontend build generates dist/frontend/browser/ which is NOT checked in. No snapshot files are committed.
environment_constraints: Backend requires MONGODB_URI in production (exits if missing). Google Sign-In requires client ID configured in frontend. SMTP (nodemailer) and web-push (VAPID keys) are installed but not configured - document required env vars. Never restart dev servers - tests run separately.
contribution_requirements: Phase 1 bug fixes are complete and approved. Build on existing code - do not duplicate. Backend trusts X-User-Id header (known security issue - do not make it worse). All user-specific data must be filtered by authenticated user on backend. Never use hardcoded or fake data. Protect all endpoints with proper authorization checks.
key_patterns: Angular: standalone components with imports array, functional routing in app.routes.ts, services use providedIn: 'root', TranslateModule for i18n with translate pipe. Backend: Express routes in routes/, controllers in controller/, models in models/, Mongoose schemas with indexes, middleware like verifiedGuard checks completed bookings. Authentication: X-User-Id header injected by auth.interceptor, authGuard protects routes, sessionStorage holds user data with key 'Loggedinuser'.
